historical_pattern.summary: Optional KLEE symbolic execution. Absence of klee or of bound bitcode is not a security result.

invariant: Symbolic execution must not invent a crashing path when the engine or bitcode is missing.
attacker_capabilities: can supply symbolic stdin or arguments when bitcode is bound
prerequisites: klee on PATH and bind.bitcode, otherwise the class holds

oracle.success_means: KLEE produced a concrete crashing test case

severity_rationale: A real KLEE counterexample is a memory-safety PoC; a missing binary is not.
